title: Yeasty Crumbly Ukrainian Celery Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring yeasty and crumbly dumplings with celery, perfect for a midnight craving, and high in protein to keep you satisfied.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat a large pot of boiling water and add the chopped celery.
Once the dough has risen, punch it down and divide it into small pieces.
Shape each piece into a dumpling and add it to the boiling water.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water and brush them with melted butter.
Drizzle the glaze over the dumplings and serve hot.
